title: Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.20631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamay

translated_title: 行动之前的指令：面向驾驶视觉-语言-动作数据的前瞻性与回顾性语言监督
translated_abstract: 驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以接受导航指令，但预测驾驶员的轨迹并不能证明模型真正遵循了该指令。我们研究驾驶-语言监督数据如何被收集与评估，区分在动作之前发出的前瞻性指令与在观察动作之后撰写的回顾性标签。我们开发了ADVLAT-Engine来同步语音指令、道路场景视频与车辆轨迹，并在48条重放路线上比较了三个导航应用。在Google Maps与乘客均播报的87个机动动作中，乘客使用更多依赖场景的语言。我们在前瞻性导航应用驾驶数据上对四个开源驾驶VLA模型进行了微调前后的评估。微调使乘客驾驶的轨迹误差降低了23-59%，但指令效果仍不一致。在真实交叉路口，反事实指令揭示了更强的响应性：微调后的Alpamay...
tldr: 本文区分了驾驶VLA数据中动作前发出的前瞻性指令与动作后撰写的回顾性标签两种语言监督方式，开发了同步语音指令、场景视频与车辆轨迹的ADVLAT-Engine，发现基于前瞻性导航指令微调可将轨迹误差降低23-59%，并通过反事实指令检验模型对指令的真实响应能力。
en_tdlr: This paper distinguishes prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it in driving VLA supervision, introduces ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and shows that fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives reduces trajectory error by 23-59%, while counterfactual instructions at real intersections probe genuine instruction-following.
